full_judgment:
7. The petitioner appeared in the execution case on 12.03.2005 and filed an application praying for lime to submit written objection; thereafter the Petitioner on 28.04.2005 filed an application under Section 57 of Artha Rin Adalat Ain. 2003 praying for dismissal of the execution case No. 68 of 2005 on the ground that the execution case has been filed in violation of provisions of Section 28 of Artha Rin Adalat Ain. 2003 and that the judgment was passed on 05.02.2004 and the decree was signed on 11.02.2004. But the execution ease has been filed on 23.02.2005 after the expiry of statutory period of 180 days and as such the instant execution case filed by the decree holder under Section 28(2) of Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 beyond the period of limitation. The Respondent No. 3. Agrani Bank opposed the said application by filing written objection. 

 (১) The Limitation Act, 1908  এবং  The Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 এ
